newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SENTRACHEM SETS UP DOW BID COMMITTEE.
newsitem.headline: SENTRACHEM SETS UP DOW BID COMMITTEE.

text.p: South African chemical firm Sentrachem Ltd, subject of a more than two billion rand offer from U.S. firm Dow Chemical Corp, said on Friday that it would set up a committee of directors to look at the bid.
The committee would be made up of directors who are not also directors of the firm's largest shareholder Sankorp, which has already accepted the offer.

"The board of Sentrachem will make a further announcement once it has had an opportunity to consider the full terms of the offer with its advisers following receipt of the formal offer document," the firm said in a statement.
It urged shareholders to exercise caution if dealing in the group's shares.
Dow is bidding 10.50 rand a share for Sentrachem.
